item.title: Robinhood (HOOD), Coinbase (COIN) & Circle (CRCL) Stocks Fall Ahead of FOMC Minutes
item.summary: Shares of Robinhood, Coinbase, and Circle all closed lower in the same session, HOOD down 4.9%, COIN down 2.9%, and CRCL down 3.8%, even as Bitcoin itself held relatively steady near $64,400.
